name: Ephraim
summary: Joseph's younger son, born in Egypt. When Jacob blessed the two boys, he put Ephraim ahead of his older brother Manasseh.

key_moments.title: Named Ephraim by Joseph
key_moments.description: Joseph named his second son Ephraim, because God had made him fruitful in the land where he had suffered.

key_moments.title: Put Ahead of Manasseh
key_moments.description: Joseph placed Manasseh at Jacob's right hand, but Jacob crossed his hands and laid his right hand on Ephraim. He said the younger brother would be greater and put Ephraim first.

key_moments.title: Mourns His Slain Sons
key_moments.description: Men of Gath killed some of Ephraim's sons in a fight over cattle. Ephraim mourned many days, and named a later son Beriah because evil had come on his house.
